Bowery Privacy Bed/Bath Door Knob (Greyson Trim) A modern privacy door knob ideal for bedrooms and bathrooms, featuring the Bowery knob paired with Greyson trim. Built from premium metal and certified for top-tier durability, it installs easily on standard interior doors. Key Features: Privacy Function: Push-button locks from the inside and unlocks with rotation or emergency pin from outside Hassle-Free Fit: Universal latch fits 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets; works with 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" door thickness Durability Certified: ANSI/BHMA Grade AAA for Security, Durability and Finish; Grade 2 mechanical Easy Installation: Self-aligning screw holes; includes both radius and drive-in faceplates Trusted Warranty: Limited lifetime mechanical and finish warranty Specifications Table: Specification Details Function Bed & Bath (Privacy) Trim Greyson Knob Bowery Finish Options Matte Black, Satin Nickel, Polished Nickel, Bright Chrome, Satin Chrome, Aged Bronze Backset Fits 2-3/8" (60mm) or 2-3/4" (70mm) Door Thickness 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" (35mm–44mm) Installation Self-aligning screw holes; includes radius and drive-in faceplates Handing Universal for right and left
